gloss: milking (a cow or other animal); expressing milk

definitions.gloss: milking (a cow or other animal); expressing milk
definitions.explanation: milking (a cow or other animal); expressing milk

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{牛|うし}の{搾乳|さくにゅう}をする。
examples.english: I milk the cows every morning.

examples.japanese: {搾乳|さくにゅう}{機|き}を{使|つか}えば{作業|さぎょう}が{効率的|こうりつてき}になる。
examples.english: Using a milking machine makes the work more efficient.

examples.japanese: {牧場|ぼくじょう}{体験|たいけん}で{子供|こども}たちは{搾乳|さくにゅう}に{挑戦|ちょうせん}して{大喜|おおよろこ}びだった。
examples.english: The children were delighted to try milking at the farm experience.

notes:
Refers to extracting milk from dairy animals (typically cows or goats) or expressing breast milk using a pump. The word is used in both agricultural and parenting contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {搾乳|さくにゅう}{機|き}: milking machine
- {搾乳|さくにゅう}{量|りょう}: amount of milk produced
- {搾乳|さくにゅう}{時間|じかん}: milking time
- {手|て}{搾|しぼ}り: hand milking (manual method)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {哺乳|ほにゅう}: nursing, suckling — the act of feeding milk to young, the opposite direction from {搾乳|さくにゅう}
- {授乳|じゅにゅう}: breastfeeding — a mother feeding her baby; differs from {搾乳|さくにゅう} which focuses on extracting the milk
- {乳搾|ちちしぼ}り: milking — a more colloquial, rustic-sounding variant
